recipe.visualDefinition: A soft-focus, backlit portrait of a woman with voluminous hair, framed by a thick dark border and anchored by high-contrast, elegant serif typography that wraps around the composition edges.
coreVisualRelationships: Text-to-frame alignment where letters bleed into or sit flush against the outer border
Backlighting creating a golden halo effect around the subject's hair against a muted background
High-contrast white typography against dark border and medium-tone photographic elements
coreInvariants: Thick dark outer border framing the central image
Soft, diffused lighting with warm highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered close-up portrait, filling approximately 70% of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the large-scale horizontal text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top horizontal text, moves down to the subject's face, then follows the vertical text on the right, ending at the subtitle in the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The thick black border provides significant structural negative space.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden-brown and cream (hair highlights and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the background with high value contrast between the text and the border.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
Flat, unbracketed or lightly bracketed serifs
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard high-contrast serif geometry

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the border and slightly touches the image area

composition.position: Bottom left corner of the inner image

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast display serif for the name paired with a softer, more legible serif for the title.

preserve: Vertical text orientation on the right

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, elegant display style of the 90s.
Suitable for the softer subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus studio portrait of a woman with voluminous 90s-style hair, backlit to create a golden glow. The subject wears a white collared shirt. The entire image is centered within a thick, solid black square border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase high-contrast serif text in white. Place one word horizontally across the top, justified to the inner edges of the border. Place a second word vertically along the right side, rotated 90 degrees clockwise. Add a three-line subtitle in a smaller, softer serif in the bottom left corner of the inner image.

verificationChecks: Is the border thick and solid black?
Is the right-side text rotated 90 degrees?
Is the lighting soft and backlit?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the subject's face
Check that the vertical text reads top-to-bottom
Verify the white text is perfectly legible against the black border
Confirm the soft-focus effect doesn't blur the typography
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a soft-focus backlit portrait with a thick dark frame and high-contrast Didone typography placed at the top and right margins.
